content.rendered: The Sherwood School District is joining Oregon’s other 196 school districts in celebrating January as “School Board Recognition Month.” As volunteers, our school board members spend countless hours year-round working to serve the students, staff, parents, and community members of Sherwood, with a focus on providing the best possible education opportunities for K-12 learners in our district. Please join us in thanking our Board of Directors for their dedication and service to our schools!
